mostWorthwhile.text: Making and releasing glycogen was the most worthwhile sequence: it showed how liver tissue can store glucose and make it available between meals.

leastWorthwhile.text: The release step felt slight on its own; its picture repeated the action without explaining when or why it happens. The following result supplied that context.

surprise.text: The between-meals explanation clarified why stored glycogen matters beyond the meal being absorbed.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary. The named portal-vessel slot and the enzyme descriptions made the choices clear, although most were predictable.

continue.text: I would be somewhat interested in another chapter to see how the connected systems work together, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than this mostly straightforward sequence.
